content.title: ‘Bloodhounds’ Season 2 Gears Up for April 3 Premiere with Hard-Hitting New Teaser and Poster -  About Netflix
content.text: Entertainment03 March 2026GlobalSouth KoreaWe’re stepping back into the ring this April 3 when Bloodhounds Season 2 premieres globally on Netflix. A new teaser poster and teaser trailer offer a first look at the tension, high stakes, and punishing blows waiting in the next chapter of this boxing revenge saga.Released in 2023, Bloodhounds gripped audiences around the world with its bare-knuckle action and the story of two young boxers taking on a ruthless loan shark operation. Three years later, Season 2 returns with a bigger stage and even higher stakes, moving into the brutal world of an underground international boxing league.Woo Do-hwan and Lee Sang-yi are back as Gun-woo and Woo-jin, now tougher and more seasoned by everything they’ve survived, while Jung Ji-hoon joins the cast in a dramatic transformation as Baek-jeong — a chilling new villain whose power in the ring is matched only by his greed.The teaser poster signals the return of the young boxing duo, standing side by side, scarred but unshaken after countless fights. The teaser trailer turns up the adrenaline, hinting at a new life-or-death round for these bloodhounds. Having taken down the loan shark ring, Gun-woo continues chasing his dream of becoming a boxing champion, with Woo-jin now in his corner as coach and chosen family. After grueling training and countless fights, Gun-woo finally claims the long-awaited victory, and the two soak in the roar of the crowd — until a new threat emerges that shakes their sense of invincibility.Enter Baek-jeong, who rules over an underground boxing league and crushes even reigning champions with ruthless ease. Driven only by money and violence, he sets his sights on Gun-woo as his next opponent. With the threat closing in, Gun-woo and Woo-jin brace for what’s coming. Once again, they’re pushed into a brutal fight to protect the people and principles that matter most.Bloodhounds Season 2 brings back even more vicious villains, next-level action, and a bigger scale to deliver a truly cathartic ride. Catch the action when it premieres globally on April 3, only on Netflix.
